acquisition_method.evidence: Acquisition parameters were set to data-dependent mode using a top 10 method, recording a high-resolution full scan (R=60,000, m/z 380-1,800) followed by higher energy collision dissociation of the 10 most intense MS peaks, excluding ions with precursor charge state of 1+ and 2+.
